changelog:
The Vault 2.0.4 

Fixes
- Fixed Handy script playback issues. Funscript playback overall is much smoother now. Fixed stutters when playing videos on high resolution videos. 
 Changed 
- To simplify the left nav bar, Stats, Recap, Quests, Hall of fame were moved to a single 'Progress' Menu. There are no new features.
- Tag manager, duplicates, console were moved to a unified 'tools' menu.
